headline: HOMEBODY puts the prover on the payroll
lede: WATCH batch 17 seats the attract autopilot on the little suburban street: press Y and the same bot that demos the game — and that peoplecheck grants the lifetime wish with — buys, clocks in and runs the household until you take the wheel.

notes.text: One brain, two jobs: the seat is autoStep (bot + advance), byte-for-byte the call the attract demo runs and the gate certifies across five seeds — watchcheck now pins the seam so a forked brain fails the build.

The honesty gate got sharper: Fern's chat, co-presence bonds and ambience hours bank needs even for an idle street, so the pilot only counts demo-gated commands — a buy, a clock-in, the payday — and proves the unseated street buys nothing and works nowhere.
Autonomy now rides the seat: every release path (Y, a driving key, a tap on the lot, the end of the run) clears the sim's demo flag, so the prover's hands leave the street exactly where they stood.

Full battery green before the merge: 56 pilots 648/648, phone law 402/402 (tripwire 56), peoplecheck 124/124, drive 25/25 with zero page errors; a seat-feed mutant lit 7 gates red and went back clean.

look.text: ADVENTURE: the seat names its driver, the decline teaches itself
